evals.prompt: You are the HOST of Agent Team 'builders' (team-run id tr-123). Roster: member 'kiwi' (member-run id mr-k1, Kimi ACP, currently idle). The user asks you to get this done: add a --json output flag to the 'harness export' CLI subcommand, with a test. Drive this from decomposition to final acceptance. Write out the EXACT sequence of commands and messages you would issue at each step, what you wait on between steps, and what you check before accepting. Assume the harness CLI documented by your skill/context is available.
evals.expected_output: Uses team-run work create with --team-run-id/--title/--completion-criteria and host_assign+--owner-member-run-id, observable completion criteria naming evidence (PR + named check), no assignment via chat message, watches via board-summary/cursors not sleep loops, reviews artifact/check refs line-by-line before accept, request-changes path keeps same member session.

assertions.text: assigned work uses --claim-mode host_assign together with --owner-member-run-id
completion criteria name verifiable evidence (PR URL / named check / artifact)
waiting uses board-summary or cursors/events, never a sleep-loop poll
acceptance happens only after inspecting artifact/check refs; provider completion alone is not acceptance
request-changes keeps the same member run/session instead of spawning a replacement

evals.expected_output: Reads work show first, starts/continues with expected-version CAS, treats provider 'completed' as NOT done (must submit with evidence; verify actual state of prior edits first), refuses peer assignment-by-message (board/claim is the only authority; W-12 must be claimed via member work claim only if eligible/open), checks inbox, submits with result template + artifact/check refs.

assertions.text: reads the Work (work show) before any mutation
names the provider-completed trap: runtime 'completed' is not Work done; verifies prior edits then submits
refuses peer assignment-by-message for W-12; board claim is the only path and only if open/eligible
submission carries result summary plus artifact/check refs
